up: Retrieve all distinct compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5725513. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL identifier (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles) if available. The document is identified via the docs table using chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725513'. Compounds are linked to documents through the activities table (via doc_id) or through compound_records (via doc_id). Return each compound only once.
sql: WITH doc AS (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725513'), compounds AS (SELECT molregno FROM compound_records WHERE doc_id = (SELECT doc_id FROM doc) AND molregno IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT molregno FROM activities WHERE doc_id = (SELECT doc_id FROM doc) AND molregno IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM compounds c JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON c.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON c.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY md.chembl_id;
